stories.h: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
stories.s: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.
b: techcrunch.com: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
techmeme.com: Supertake, which uses AI agents to turn users' market predictions into investment portfolios via Coinbase and Robinhood, raised a $20M seed led by Adjacent (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
body: techcrunch.com: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.

techmeme.com: Sarah Perez / TechCrunch : Supertake, which uses AI agents to turn users' market predictions into investment portfolios via Coinbase and Robinhood, raised a $20M seed led by Adjacent AI investing startup Supertake has an interesting premise: what if your takes on the market could make you money without you having to pick stocks yourself?
